description.en: The filter rules for the component.

description.zh: 某个组件下的返回内容里面的单个值的名称(N取值范围1-5)。
description.en: The name of the component property. Valid values of N: 1 to 5.

description.zh:
组件的比较符(N取值范围1-5)。
取值范围：
- Equal
- NotEqual
- BeginWith
- LessThan
- GreaterThan
description.en:
The comparison operator that is used to filter property values. Valid values of N: 1 to 5. Valid values:

*   Equal
*   NotEqual
*   BeginWith
*   LessThan
*   GreaterThan

description.zh: 组件返回结果的名称都对应的值(第一个N的取值范围1-5，第二个N的取值范围为1-20)。
description.en: The values of properties. Valid values of the first N: 1 to 5. Valid values of the second N: 1 to 20.

description.zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1-100。默认为50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50.
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

description.zh:
组件名称。
取值范围：

- ACS:InstanceInformation
- ACS:Application
- ACS:File
- ACS:Network
- ACS:WindowsRole
- ACS:Service
- ACS:WindowsRegistry
- ACS:WindowsUpdate
description.en:
The name of the component. Valid values:

*   ACS:InstanceInformation
*   ACS:Application
*   ACS:File
*   ACS:Network
*   ACS:WindowsRole
*   ACS:Service
*   ACS:WindowsRegistry
*   ACS:WindowsUpdate

title.zh: 查询一个实例下的配置清单记录

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-inventory-entries --instance-id i-bp1cpoxxxwxxxxxxxxxx --type-name ACS:InstanceInformation --max-results 50 --next-token MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzA --filter '[{"Operator":"Equal","Value":["ubuntu"],"Name":"PlatformName"}]' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos ListInventoryEntries --region cn-hangzhou --TypeName 'ACS:InstanceInformation' --NextToken MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzA --InstanceId 'i-bp1cpoxxxwxxxxxxxxxx' --Filter.1.Value.1 ubuntu --MaxResults 50 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Operator Equal --Filter.1.Name PlatformName
